content_sections.body: Read this model: 'I have considered media experiences, and my experience shows one useful reason for this view.' Identify the main point, the linking expression, and the supporting detail. Then explain how the wording helps the speaker achieve this objective: Relate media experiences and distinguish finished from current relevance.
content_sections.title: Notice the connected language (10 minutes)

content_sections.body: Work with a partner in a discussion about media experiences. Give a clear main point, support it with a specific reason, and respond to one follow-up question. Use tactful language when the other speaker presents a different perspective.
content_sections.title: Guided exchange (10 minutes)

content_sections.body: Prepare a one-minute response about media experiences. Organize it into thought groups, stress the words that carry your main point, and finish with a concise conclusion rather than a list of isolated sentences.
content_sections.title: Independent connected response (8 minutes)
